description:
A big thunderstorm (rain, claps), recorded with two AKG C414EB, Daking IV preamp and Lavry Blue converter.

This was really a heavy one with many many thunders. Unfortunatelly the peak of the storm wasn't very usefull/interesting, because the overal rumble was so loud and consistent that individual claps weren't distinct enough. This recording is from the calmer part.


Please don't put my raw sounds/files on youtube or anywere else. You can use it in creative way as a part of some artform, but not "re-distribute them". Thank you.
